title: Yummy Portuguese Salmon Dumplings
description: Sashimi‑cut salmon wrapped in fluffy egg roll wrappers, seasoned with Portuguese spices, then pan‑fried and finished in the oven for a crispy, indulgent bite.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add olive oil.
Spread the olive oil evenly across the pan.
Place a spoonful of seasoned salmon on each wrapper and fold into a triangle, sealing the edges with a touch of water.
Gently press the dumplings to ensure they are sealed tightly.
Arrange the dumplings on the skillet, leaving space between them.
Cook for 2 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Preheat the oven to 200C and transfer the pan to the oven to finish cooking the dumplings for 5 minutes.
Remove from oven and let rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Serve with a drizzle of soy sauce and a wedge of lemon.
Optional: garnish with extra dill or parsley for freshness.
